caption:
A thrown ball is flying. So is a balloon.

Flight is simply moving through air or space without touching a planet's surface. There is more than one way to do it: lift, buoyancy, or ballistic movement.

The catch? A thrown ball counts. Balls, arrows, bullets and fireworks make little or no lift. They move on momentum, gravity and air drag, and that is called ballistic flight.

The payoff? Birds, bats, insects, gliding animals, certain seeds and spores, balloons, aircraft and rockets all fly. The list is much longer than wings alone. ✈️

Source: Wikipedia — Flight
